cases.prompt: Rewrite this draft fragment in clean human prose. Keep the engineer quotation verbatim and attributed.

must_contain: We shipped on Friday and nobody noticed.

rubric: Every verb and noun keeps its literal dictionary meaning in context (Rule 1).
No closing moral or poster aphorism appears at the end (Rule 10).
The rewrite preserves the original facts without inventing scenes or metrics.

cases.prompt: Turn this fragment into a drafted blog section with a title and Sources. Keep the engineer quote verbatim.

must_contain: We shipped on Friday and nobody noticed.

rubric: Seed phrases outside the marked quotation are rewritten rather than copied verbatim.
Headings state a concrete claim rather than a stock pair or generic label.

cases.prompt: Fact-check this draft before publication and output a <fact_check_report>.
rubric: Flags the 4 GB/day statistic as unverifiable.
Flags the Nordlake Analytics 2025 report as fabricated or not found.
Flags ops.example.invalid as a broken link and blocks publication.
Does not invent a replacement source for unverifiable claims.

cases.prompt: Draft this argument directly in Pass 2 without an outline: observability made our team faster. Notes: dashboards, alerts, logs.
rubric: Emits a structural escalation back to Pass 1 rather than forcing a thin draft.

cases.prompt: Turn these plain notes into a styled flowing A4 HTML document in AG Style v1.0.
rubric: Preserves the supplied meaning and facts without unrequested rewrites.
Uses warm paper ground, weight-400 Georgia headings, uppercase Inter kickers, and one burgundy accent per block.

cases.prompt: Create a 6-slide Marp deck on why deterministic skill gates beat prompt-only reviews, using AG Style v1.0.
rubric: One clear idea per slide with concise bullets (max 6 per slide).
No exclamation marks, no emoji, and declarative From the trenches register.

cases.prompt: Audit this finished draft for bibliographic defects and quote drift without altering the title, headings, or opening paragraph.

must_contain: Opening paragraph describing a quiet room on the twelfth floor.

rubric: Replaces secondary wrapper URLs cited as studies with primary sources or clarifies attribution.
Fixes inline/source year mismatch and missing author surname without rewriting surrounding prose.
Preserves the opening paragraph, title, and section headings intact.
